$comment: Single source of truth for all Windows MIDI Services App SDK version numbers.
build.ps1 stamps this into the NuGet nuspec, BundleInfo.wxi, and every MSBuild
Version/FileVersion/AssemblyVersion property. Do not hand-edit versions anywhere else.
build:         monotonic build counter. build.ps1 -BumpBuildNumber increments it.
CI can override with -BuildNumber <n> without touching this file.
IMPORTANT: Windows Installer only compares the first THREE fields of a version.
Bump 'patch' for any release that must upgrade over a previously installed one.
